FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(KL−KUALA SELANGOR EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private

Management) (Collection of Tolls) (KL−Kuala Selangor Expressway)

(Amendment) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(KL−Kuala Selangor Expressway) Order 2014 [P.U. (A) 344/2014] is amended by

substituting for the First Schedule the following schedule:

axles and wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of

the axles and wheels of the vehicle.".
